description: Reverse-ETL / search-index activation: sync an upstream DataFrame into an OpenSearch index via the native _bulk NDJSON API. id_field's value becomes each document's _id; all other columns become source fields. Supports 'upsert' (index action, create-or-replace) and 'delete' (delete action, no source line).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one OpenSearch document, keyed by id_field -> _id.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_submitted / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_id / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in OpenSearch.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

id_field.label: ID Field
id_field.description: Upstream column whose value becomes the OpenSearch document's _id.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: 'upsert' create-or-replaces via the index bulk action; 'delete' removes via the delete bulk action.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: OpenSearch Index Upsert
